title: AI Assurance common diagnostic run contract
description: Version-discriminated diagnostic contract: legacy 1.0, hosted 1.1 and authenticated external audit projection 1.2. Schema validity is distinct from result origin, input custody, statistical suitability and legal sufficiency.

parameters.description: Validated against the selected test registry schema; cannot contain arbitrary executable code or SQL.

interactiveThresholds.description: Prototype calculator settings; production approval/provenance is a separate gate.

slice.description: Minimized/pseudonymized labels. Avoid exposing small sensitive groups in client exports.

isolation.const: SQLite read transaction; mode=ro; query_only; no user SQL

inputHashes.description: Actual consumed artifacts only. Saved-prediction runner hashes data/reference; it must not invent a model hash.

card.description: Frozen dataset governance card; application validation enforces its version, artifact hash, and engagement.

hostedRun.description: Hosted v1.1 saved-prediction execution with frozen model/card, dataset, protocol and configuration snapshots. SHA-256 values describe content; authenticity and cross-field equality require the application validator.

card.description: Frozen dataset governance card; application validation enforces its version, artifact hash, and engagement.

externalPredictionDataset.description: External immutable input snapshot. rowCount is the maximum reported metric sample size in this projection, not a verified source-population census.

externalAuditRun.description: Authenticated external attempt projected into an audit run. Exact external report bytes remain preserved separately; application validation enforces request, lease, nonce, input and authority bindings.
